record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.original_question: Let p > 2 and let Ω be the unit disk in R^2 with boundary condition g(x)=x on ∂Ω. For the p-Ginzburg-Landau energy Eε,p(u) = (1/p)∫Ω |∇u|^p + (1/(4ε^2))∫Ω (|u|^2 - 1)^2 on W^{1,p}_g(Ω; R^2), if uε is any minimizer or any critical point, does uε(x) converge to x/|x| for every x in Ω \ {0} as ε → 0?

evidence.quote: One can also raise identical questions for the p−GL energy Eε,p(u) := 1/p ∫Ω |∇u|p + 1/(4ε2) ∫Ω (|u|2 − 1)2, where p > 1, Ω is the unit disc in R2 and u ∈ W1,p g(Ω; R2), with g(x) = x on ∂Ω.
Open Problem 2.3 ([BM, Open Problem 30]). Assume p > 2 and let uε be any minimizer (resp. critical point) of Eε,p on W1,p g(Ω, R2). Does uε(x) → x/|x| in Ω \ {0} as ε → 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be the open unit disk and let $p > 2$. For $\varepsilon > 0$, consider the $p$-Ginzburg–Landau energy
$$E_{\varepsilon,p}(u) \;=\; \frac{1}{p}\int_\Omega |\nabla u|^p\,dx \;+\; \frac{1}{4\varepsilon^2}\int_\Omega \bigl(|u|^2 - 1\bigr)^2\,dx,$$
defined on the affine Sobolev space
$$W^{1,p}_g(\Omega; \mathbb{R}^2) \;=\; \bigl\{\, u \in W^{1,p}(\Omega; \mathbb{R}^2) : u(x) = g(x) = x \text{ for } x \in \partial\Omega \,\bigr\}.$$
Let $u_\varepsilon \in W^{1,p}_g(\Omega;\mathbb{R}^2)$ be either a minimizer of $E_{\varepsilon,p}$ or, more generally, an arbitrary critical point of $E_{\varepsilon,p}$ on $W^{1,p}_g(\Omega;\mathbb{R}^2)$.

Prove or disprove: as $\varepsilon \to 0$,
$$u_\varepsilon(x) \;\longrightarrow\; \frac{x}{|x|} \qquad \text{for every } x \in \Omega \setminus \{0\}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The literature contains partial progress on asymptotics of p-Ginzburg–Landau minimizers (e.g., convergence in W^{1,p} and C^{1,α} for radial or higher-dimensional analogues, and stability of radial minimizers for 2 < p ≤ 4), but no source confirms the asymptotic radial symmetry x/|x| for arbitrary minimizers or critical points on the unit disk with boundary data g(x)=x. The problem is listed as an open problem and appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Radially symmetric minimizers for a p-Ginzburg Landau type energy in R^2
status_evidence.snippet: The radially symmetric solution is locally stable for 2 < p ≤ 4; uniqueness within the radial class is established.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results are known, restricted to the radial class and stability rather than full convergence of arbitrary critical points to x/|x|.

status_evidence.title: C^{1,α} convergence of a Ginzburg–Landau type minimizer in higher dimensions
status_evidence.snippet: Convergence results in W^{1,p} and C^{1,α} senses are obtained for a p-Ginzburg–Landau type minimizer.
status_evidence.claim: Related convergence results exist but do not directly resolve the planar problem with g(x)=x for general critical points.
